title: Design: same-day invoices on A/R Collection keep the time order
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has three overdue invoices dated the same day: {Invoice-A}, {Invoice-B} and {Invoice-C}, numbered in that order, where {Invoice-C} was invoiced first that day, then {Invoice-A}, then {Invoice-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-79 Same Day; {Invoice-A} is S3-14690, {Invoice-B} S3-14691 and {Invoice-C} S3-15660 (the app assigns the real numbers).
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Customer-A}'s group expanded.
  • The design picture "The customer row stays pinned" (ar-ap-p3-the-customer-row-stays-pinned.png) is attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the order of {Invoice-A}, {Invoice-B} and {Invoice-C}.
  2. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the CSV and read the same three rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Invoice-C} first, then {Invoice-A}, then {Invoice-B}: same-day invoices follow the time they were invoiced, not their numbers (option (b) of the question; the picture lists same-day invoices out of number order).
  • Step 2: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 3: the same order as on screen.

Held: this is the design's version of a difference from the PRD. Question 14 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026) decides it. If the design wins, this case is released and the PRD-following cases change; if the PRD wins, this case is deleted with the QA lead's go-ahead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • S1-R6: “A/R Collection groups by customer and A/P Unpaid Invoices by vendor, groups in name order (S1-R2 to S1-R4); inside each group, rows open oldest date first, ties by document number (S2-R4).”
  • S1-R4: “Two names that compare equal are ordered by the plain lower-cased name, then by the customer or vendor itself, so the same two customers always come out in the same order on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html). This held case follows the design picture below, not the PRD sentence quoted above (Rule 130 item 5): the quote shows what the PRD says today, the picture what the design shows.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p3-the-customer-row-stays-pinned.png: figure "The customer row stays pinned" (This build (after)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows"

The design's own words:

  • "While scrolling a group, its row stays under the column headings; the next group's row pushes it up and off. S4-R6." (caption of "The customer row stays pinned")

Difference from the PRD (DD-04): the PRD says "inside each group, rows open oldest date first, ties by document number (S2-R4)" (S1-R6); the design shows in the CMLZ Truck Repair - Talladega group five invoices dated Aug 27, 2026 read S3-14690, S3-14693, S3-15660, S3-14691, S3-14692 (not number order). This held case follows the design; the difference is question 14 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026); the design version is this case.
